notes: Added missing stories to complete schema/contract, core logic, API integration, and testing coverage.

FEAT-5-S95.title: Tool Schema Registry and Pydantic Contract Mapping
FEAT-5-S95.description: Define and centralize mapping between allowed tool names and their corresponding Pydantic validation models, ensuring a single source of truth for tool input contracts.

FEAT-5-S96.title: Core Tool Dispatch Execution Pipeline
FEAT-5-S96.description: Implement the end-to-end dispatch pipeline: receive normalized tool request, validate against allowlist and schema, invoke the correct domain service or facade, and return structured response.

FEAT-5-S97.title: FastAPI Integration for Tool Routing
FEAT-5-S97.description: Integrate tool routing into the FastAPI request lifecycle, ensuring tool dispatch is invoked within the agent loop and responses are correctly surfaced to the chat frontend.

FEAT-5-S98.title: Unit Tests for Allowlist and Validation Logic
FEAT-5-S98.description: Create unit tests covering allowlist enforcement, schema validation success/failure, and rejection paths for invalid or malformed tool inputs.

FEAT-5-S99.title: End-to-End Tool Routing Integration Tests
FEAT-5-S99.description: Implement integration tests simulating full tool-use flows from Anthropic tool_use input through routing, validation, service invocation, and response generation.
